## Venue

::: {.event-summary}
**Komatsu Hall**<br>
Research Innovation Center (Building 121), B1F<br>
Waseda University, Tokyo<br>
30–31 October 2026
:::

The in-person components of the Japan QCA Conference take place at Komatsu Hall. The PDW is in person, while the EW is hybrid, combining in-person and online participation. Komatsu Hall is on the basement first floor of Waseda University's Research Innovation Center, identified as **Building 121** on the official campus map.

**Address**<br>
513 Wasedatsurumakicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo 162-0041, Japan

[View the official Waseda campus map (PDF) ↗](https://www.waseda.jp/top/en/assets/uploads/2022/06/waseda-campus-map_202109.pdf){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
[Building 121 information ↗](https://www.waseda.jp/inst/research/en/org/bldg121){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

## Access information

The walking times published by Waseda University for Building 121 are:

- Tokyo Metro Tozai Line: approximately **3 minutes** from Waseda Station
- Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line: approximately **16 minutes** from Nishi-Waseda Station
- JR Yamanote Line or Seibu Shinjuku Line: approximately **21 minutes** from Takadanobaba Station

Detailed reception, campus-entry, step-free access, and EW online-participation instructions will be added when confirmed. Please do not contact a Waseda University office about the conference; conference questions should be sent to [jqca2026@gmail.com](mailto:jqca2026@gmail.com).
